title: SWF compile: CsmTextSettings (tag 74) not emitted on main-timeline text path
description: Golden-pair oracle deviation. Real Flash 8 emits a CsmTextSettings (tag 74, FlashType anti-alias) record immediately after EACH text definition. Our compiler emits none on the main timeline (golden-report: CsmTextSettings ours=0/golden=3). Task 1131 fixed this only for text inside symbol timelines (sprite.ts); the scene/main-timeline compile path in compile.ts still omits it for both DefineText and DefineEditText. Acceptance: golden-report shows CsmTextSettings 3/3. Related (done): 1131, 0805, 0821.
